title: Solving Problems Like an Engineer
seo_title: Grade 2 Engineering Worksheets: Define a Problem, Shape and Function, Compare Designs
standard_text: Ask questions, make observations, and gather information about a situation people want to change to define a simple problem that can be solved through the development of a new or improved object or tool. Develop a simple sketch, drawing, or physical model to illustrate how the shape of an object helps it function as needed to solve a given problem. Analyze data from tests of two objects designed to solve the same problem to compare the strengths and weaknesses of how each performs.
meta_desc: Free grade 2 engineering worksheets (NGSS K-2-ETS1): define a problem, see how shape helps objects work, and compare test data from two designs. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Engineers solve problems and use tests to pick the best design.
body_html:
How to think about it

Engineers solve problems step by step.

  • Ask: what is the problem?
  • Draw it: the shape helps it work.
  • Test two designs and compare.
Example

Crayons roll off a desk. What is the problem?

What needs to change?

Answer: Crayons need something to stop them rolling.

Example

A foil boat held 20 pennies, a paper boat held 9. Which is better?

More pennies is better.

Answer: the foil boat

Common mistakes

  • Building before you know the problem.
  • Choosing the prettiest design, not the one that works.
  • Testing only once.

faq.q: How do kids compare two designs?
